care.summary: Chinese evergreen cultivar with bold red/pink variegation; tolerant of lower indoor light.
care.light: Low to bright indirect; protect from harsh midday sun that bleaches red tones
care.water: Water when the top 2–3 cm of soil feels dry; reduce in cool months
care.soil: Well-draining indoor potting mix with some perlite
care.humidity: Average to medium; likes a little extra humidity for crisp leaf edges
care.fertilizer: Dilute balanced liquid monthly in spring/summer
care.toxicity: Toxic if ingested (calcium oxalate crystals) — keep away from pets and children
common_issues: Faded red variegation in deep shade
Brown tips from dry air or fluoride-heavy water
tips: Wipe dust so red patterning stays vivid
